steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Commonwealth is a voluntary association of 56 independent countries with a combined population of 2.5 billion people, most with historic ties to Britain through the former British Empire.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Commonwealth promotes shared values: democracy, human rights, the rule of law, and sustainable development. The Commonwealth Charter sets out these principles, but membership is voluntary and enforcement is limited.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meetings (CHOGM) are held every two years to discuss shared challenges and set the organisation's direction. The King is the Head of the Commonwealth.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The United Nations (UN) was founded in 1945 to maintain international peace, develop friendly relations, and promote human rights. It has 193 member states.
